concerns.text: The primary OSM source 'Mead0w1ark/megaearth-osm-sentinel2/.../classes_final.parquet' is a machine-learning classification table (OSM+Sentinel2), not a per-city OSM vector extract of buildings/land-use/trees/roads. URL reachability aside, this dataset does not plausibly provide the geometry-bearing layers FR-001 requires for the 10 configured US cities.

concerns.location: research.md:Dataset Strategy table, row 'OSM vectors (parquet, alt.)'
concerns.text: 'arbml/Osman_Un_Corpus/.../train-00000-of-00001-c160156ed7df8ea7.parquet' is an Arabic NLP text corpus, not OpenStreetMap vector data. Citing it as an OSM vector source is a wrong-dataset error; it cannot yield building/land-use/tree/road geometries.

concerns.location: research.md:Dataset Strategy table, rows 'OSM tiles' and 'OSM country parquet (alt.)'
concerns.text: The PeakNav tile archive is a single zoom-5 slippy tile (no feature geometry at analysis resolution), and the open2roam extract covers country=AG (Antigua), not any of the 10 US cities in config.py CITY_LIST. Neither fallback can supply city-scale OSM vectors for the planned analysis.

City boundaries are claimed to be 'derived from the verified OSM sources above', but since none of the cited sources actually contain OSM place polygons for the target cities, the boundary-derivation strategy has no viable data foundation. The plan needs a genuinely appropriate OSM extract source (e.g., Geofabrik regional extracts or an OSM PBF/parquet source covering the configured cities) added to the verified block.
